calculation_handling.description: A secondary suite is permitted in a detached house.
calculation_handling.gaps: Chapter 150 applies across zones; the unit text names no zone, so zones is left empty.

calculation_handling.description: A secondary suite is permitted in a semi-detached house.
calculation_handling.gaps: Chapter 150 applies across zones; the unit text names no zone, so zones is left empty.

calculation_handling.description: A secondary suite is permitted in a townhouse.
calculation_handling.gaps: Chapter 150 applies across zones; the unit text names no zone, so zones is left empty.

calculation_handling.description: Within a detached house, semi-detached house or townhouse, each dwelling unit may have at most one secondary suite.
calculation_handling.gaps: A maximum count of secondary suites per dwelling unit, but vocab.dsl_target has no suites-per-unit target, so it is keyed as a PERMIT of up to one suite and the 'one' is listed as an application threshold rather than a LIMIT expression. No zone is named in the text.

calculation_handling.description: A secondary suite is permitted within a lawfully existing detached house, semi-detached house or townhouse in the RA, RAC, CL, CR, I, IH, IE, IS and IPW zones (where those building types are not otherwise permitted).
calculation_handling.gaps: The named zones (RA, RAC, CL, CR, I, IH, IE, IS, IPW) are not in vocab.zone, so zones is empty; the unit does not apply in the R, RD, RS, RT or RM zones. Depends on an existing building's lawful status.

units.disclosure: In certain apartment, commercial-residential and institutional zones, a secondary suite is allowed inside a lawfully existing house or townhouse. These zones are outside our residential coverage and we cannot confirm a building's lawful status.

150.10.20.1(1).explanation: A secondary suite (for example a basement apartment) is allowed in a detached house, a semi-detached house or a townhouse.

150.10.20.1(2).explanation: Each home in a detached house, semi-detached house or townhouse can have at most one secondary suite.

150.10.20.1(4).explanation: In certain zones where houses and townhouses are not otherwise permitted (RA, RAC, CL, CR, I, IH, IE, IS and IPW), a secondary suite is still allowed inside a lawfully existing detached house, semi-detached house or townhouse.
